title: Eight AI Tools, Eight Copies of the Loan: The Reconciliation Work and the Fractured Audit Trail Nobody Priced Into the Stack
summary: A lender buys the best extraction tool, the best income tool, the best QC tool, and ends up with eight copies of the same loan that have to be reconciled by hand and an audit trail scattered across eight vendors. The hidden cost is not the license fees. It is the integration tax, the HMDA data-integrity exposure when the systems disagree, and the fair-lending record you cannot assemble because no single system holds the decision. Why shared state beats best-of-breed in a regulated process.
